# Fast Scheduler

> Telegram bot that schedules and auto-publishes posts to Telegram channels — batch scheduling, recurring messages, sender bots, statistics, backups and team permissions.

- Official site: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule
- Bot: https://t.me/FastSchedulerBot
- Support / feedback bot (a human reads every ticket): https://t.me/FastSchedulerSupport_bot
- Help Center (interactive search): https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help.html
- Blog (Telegram channel growth guides): https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/blog/ (68 articles)
- Full help corpus for AI retrieval: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/llms-full.txt (308 articles)
- Pricing: Free plan (1 channel, 100 pending scheduled messages, 100 sends/channel/month, 1 recurring message); Premium $6.83/month or $68.03/year (3 channels, unlimited sends, unlimited recurring, bigger uploads, leaderboards, backups).
- Privacy Policy: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/legal/privacy.html
- Terms: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/legal/terms.html
- Refund Policy: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/legal/refundpolicy.html

### Connecting a Bot
Every channel needs its own sender bot - a Telegram bot you own that posts messages to your channel under the bot's name. Why Connect Your Own Bot? • Messages are sent from YOUR bot, not the main bot  Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/connect_bot.html

### Quick Tips
• Use HH:MM alone to schedule for today at that time. • Upload a .txt file during scheduling to create many messages at once (blank line = new message). • Use Message List ( /list ) to edit or delete  Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/start_tips.html

### Glossary
Six terms cover most of the bot: • Channel — the Telegram channel your posts go to. The bot must be its admin. • Sender bot — your own bot that actually delivers the posts. Required for every channel; Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/glossary.html

### Channel

### Sender Bot
A sender bot is a Telegram bot you create via @BotFather. Fast Scheduler uses it to post messages so they appear from your bot's name. Every channel needs one sender bot - connecting it is required af Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/glossary_sender.html

### Signature

### Recurring

### Import
Import brings data back into the bot from a file: a .fsback backup, a .txt list of messages, a .csv spreadsheet, or a schedule created in SetDate. Use Import from the main menu (or /import ) and send  Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/glossary_import.html

### Export
Export saves your data to a file you can download and keep. You can export scheduled and recurring messages, or run a full backup (.fsback) that restores everything - channels, bots, settings, media.  Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/glossary_export.html

### Media Storage
Media storage lets you save photos, videos, and documents once, then reuse them in any scheduled message via From Storage . Items are kept until you delete them - they are never removed automatically  Full guide: https://fastschedulebot.github.io/Fast-Schedule/help/a/glossary_storage.html
